T: The Kessel Run. One full plate.
D: Young Han Solo joins a crew of thieves and meets Chewbacca and Lando on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when Han sits down at the card table with Lando.
S: Warm roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, mixed olives
Roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, and a bowl of marinated olives on the card table.
Han's lucky pair of gold dice

Cubes of haloumi dusted in smoked paprika and fried golden on every side, drizzled with hot honey and lemon, with pips of toasted sesame like dice spots. Cut 2 blocks of haloumi, about 500g, into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Toss in 2 tbsp flour mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika. Fry in a little oil over medium high heat for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and the juice of half a lemon. Drizzle over the cubes and dot with toasted black and white sesame seeds.
Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with chilli oil and black vinegar
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil and black vinegar to dip.
M: Pork knuckle roasted until the crackling blisters, with buttered potatoes

Pork knuckles simmered with caraway and bay, then roasted until the crackling blisters, with warm sauerkraut, buttered potatoes and wholegrain mustard. Simmer 2 pork knuckles with an onion, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp caraway seeds for 1.5 hours. Pat very dry, score, rub with salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes until the crackling blisters. Boil 800g potatoes and toss with butter and parsley. Warm 500g sauerkraut with a little of the cooking liquid. Serve with wholegrain mustard.
First Light duck with cherry and port
the glittering party on Dryden Vos's yacht, the First Light

Duck breasts scored and rendered until the skin crackles, sliced pink over silky celeriac purée with a cherry and port sauce and crisp kale. Simmer a peeled, chopped celeriac in milk and water for 20 minutes, drain and blitz with 40g butter. Score 4 duck breasts, start skin side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, then flip and roast at 200C for 6 minutes. Rest. Pour off most fat, add 100ml port, 200g pitted cherries and 150ml stock and reduce until glossy. Bake kale leaves with oil until crisp.
W: Dark chocolate bark with popping candy and freeze-dried raspberries

Dark chocolate bark spread thin and scattered with popping candy, freeze-dried raspberries and sea salt that crackles and fizzes as you eat it. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 300g dark chocolate over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth. Spread thin on the tray. While still soft, scatter with 2 sachets popping candy, 15g freeze-dried raspberries and a few sea salt flakes. Set in the fridge for 30 minutes, then snap into jagged shards.
K: Bourbon, honey syrup and orange bitters stirred over a big ice cube
Bourbon stirred with honey syrup and orange bitters over a big ice cube, with orange peel.
